_comment: C7 recipe net (plan-content-zones12.md §13/§A): the CAPSTONE — Vanguard + Spearhead + CallForAid at the levels below → Warbanner. Top of the power ceiling. Tiered behind Spearhead (backlog §21, PO 2026-07-19): the capstone must unlock strictly AFTER the Spearhead ceiling combo — Spearhead 5 forces real investment past the cascade's L1 discovery, and Vanguard 5 stays explicit so a free respec out of Vanguard can't shortcut the warlord build. Secret — never documented in-game. ⚑ NUMBERS REWRITE C2a: ingredient levels are ABSOLUTE and did NOT move with the cap pass (PO 2026-07-31), so an ingredient named at 5 whose cap is now 10 unlocks this half-way up its curve rather than at its ceiling. Re-pointing them at the new caps was rejected — two maxed cap-10 skills cost 32 points against a 29-point level-30 budget, which would make the recipe unreachable.
